title: Drop, don't patch
statement: Drop an item whose fact can't be traced to a cited source rather than patching the gap with a generated claim.
detail: Adopted for new AP training sets after model-written source text was blamed for most factual failures of document-based items (`icloud-work/auto-memory-backup/feedback_no_hallucination_in_training_data.md`, lines 15-19). The project judged that allowing generated text anywhere in a curated set would recreate the same failure, and ruled that a record with a fact that can't be cited to a primary source is dropped, not patched (line 33). The rule still allows prompts, reference answers and connecting text written by hand (lines 27-29). Handovers from the same work extend the rule to any source or data row that fails an audit: drop it rather than rework it until it passes.
against: The same project later had a model write items from verified facts and kept those the grader passed: "- v29 SFT data: pull all KCs per course, generate one MCQ + one SAQ per KC using the bundled scaffolding as the prompt context, IB-grade, keep ≥0.85" (`icloud-work/auto-memory-backup/reference_curriculum_api_lan.md`, line 85). No result of applying the rule is recorded. The later generation service repaired rather than dropped: when the model returns malformed JSON, the route repairs the schema from the retrieved context (the generation service's `README.md`, line 30), and a later spec mutates a failing candidate to address the criterion it failed (`99stack_layer4_repair_spec.md`, line 14). Both repair generated items, not sources or data rows.

evidence.quote: **Drop-don't-patch rule:** if a fact in a candidate record can't be cited to a primary source, the record gets dropped from the corpus, not patched with a synthesized claim.

If we curate a "real-source corpus" but allow LLM-generated content anywhere in it (gold responses, glue text, paraphrased document text), we recreate the same failure mode. **The point of curation is verified facts; hallucination defeats the purpose.**
- v29 SFT data: pull all KCs per course, generate one MCQ + one SAQ per KC using the bundled scaffolding as the prompt context, IB-grade, keep ≥0.85
